summary.zh: 稻田与湿地常见的白色中型鹭。
summary.en: A medium white heron common in paddies and wetlands.

field_marks.zh: 全身白，黑嘴、黑腿、黄脚趾；繁殖期头后有两根长饰羽。
field_marks.en: All white with a black bill, black legs and yellow toes; two long head plumes in the breeding season.

similar.zh: 大白鹭体型更大、嘴黄色；牛背鹭较矮胖。
similar.en: Great egret is larger with a yellow bill; cattle egret is stockier.

story.zh: 鹭科在鸟类系统树上属于鹈形目。鸟类深层关系在不同基因组研究间有分歧，但科内关系较稳定。
story.en: Herons sit in Pelecaniformes. Deep bird relationships differ across genome studies, but family-level groupings are more stable.

notes.zh: 全年可见，春季繁殖期饰羽最漂亮；稻田灌水期是观察高峰。
notes.en: Visible all year; plumes are best in spring; flooded paddies are a good place to look.
